title: Nanobanana requests get the right access path
summary:
A small garden-maintenance day: smoother Nanobanana access, more predictable image routing, and cleaner community tooling.

Requests from enter.pollinations.ai now bypass hourly limits for Nanobanana, keeping that experience available without an unnecessary limit check in the way.

The Cloudflare Flux fallback has been disabled, reducing unexpected fallback behavior and keeping image requests on the intended path.

Logos now come from one source of truth, while Discord Digests can be generated on a time interval—less visual drift, fewer missed community conversations.

highlights.title: Next-Gen Models
highlights.text: Access **GPT-5 Nano** and **GPT-4.1** via the text API, plus **Gemini 2.5 Flash** is now active. [Text API](https://enter.pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: ReImagine Mobile App
highlights.text: A new open-source React Native application for transforming images on the go. [Try it](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ismafly.reimagine)

highlights.title: Opposite Prompt Generator
highlights.text: A creative tool that generates the semantic opposite of your image prompts. [Try it](https://opposite-prompt-generator.pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: Simplified Text API
highlights.text: Developers can now use `/api/generate/text/:prompt` for instant generation and pass auth tokens via URL parameters. [API Docs](https://enter.pollinations.ai/api/docs)
